youtube_title: The U.S. Government Can Use Your Patent Without Asking — Then Pay
caption: Under 28 U.S.C. §1498, when the U.S. government (or an authorized contractor) uses a patented invention without a license, the owner's remedy is compensation from the government in the Court of Federal Claims.
